args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.

Hi Dana, I went through all six of Moss's notes in the share. Two of them mention Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

• *#PD-4492*: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because gatehouse kiosk SMS bay assignments weren't reaching drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard. Support patched it the same evening and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct. The note also says to review the ticket so the kiosk logs get archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
• *#4419*: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

A few things to know:
• Moss's 9/14 North pipeline digest covers QFL but has no ticket number. The 3/23 renewal note has none either.
• Tickets #4409 and #4412 and FR-882, in Moss's Central notes, belong to Central accounts, not QFL.
• Marcus's note about "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company, a non-customer, so I left it out.
• The two numbers are formatted differently (one has the PD- prefix, one doesn't), and the cheat sheet has no date. You may want to check both against the ticket system before they go in the weekly notes.

I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in our direct message, replying to her message. I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay-assignment texts from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I also told Dana what I left out and why:
- Moss's 14 Sept 2025 North pipeline digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note both mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 and the feature request FR-882 are in Moss's Central team notes and belong to Central accounts, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, and it isn't one of Moss's notes.

The two numbers are formatted differently (only one has the "PD-" prefix), and the cheat sheet isn't dated. I suggested Dana check both in the ticket system before they go into the weekly notes.
